finalText:
I worked all nine open flight-change requests. Q-306 is a cancellation, so I left it for its own team. The system date was 2026-07-28, not the 2026-10-05 in the task, so I treated 27 July as "yesterday". I didn't re-read the reservations or ledgers after the changes. I haven't messaged any passengers; each got a note through the request resolution.

Every change kept the booked cabin. The charges below went through as separate ledger entries.

| Request | Passenger | New flight | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 | Ines Duarte (R5201) | DL542, 6 Aug | $0 | Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14) covers her. |
| Q-302 | Jonah Pike (R5202) | AA664, 7 Aug | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | No waiver applies, so normal economy rules. |
| Q-303 | Kim Seo (R5203) | AA664, 7 Aug | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The Boston waiver (PB-2026-09) expired 15 July. The basic economy fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, and silver isn't exempt. |
| Q-304 | Lena Ortiz (R5204) | UA90, 9 Aug | $35 fare difference | Change fee waived. The waiver still collects fare differences on basic economy. |
| Q-305 | Max Weber (R5205) | AA216, 8 Aug | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | He booked on 26 July, after the waiver's 24 July ticketing cut-off, so normal rules apply. |
| Q-307 | Oscar Lund (R5207) | AA218, 8 Aug | $0 | As a platinum member his window runs through 5 Aug (PB-2026-14A), so he is covered. |
| Q-308 | Petra Novak (R5208) | AA662, 5 Aug | $75 | Same-day flat fee under PB-2026-12, with no fare difference. |
| Q-309 | Quinn Adler (R5209) | Chicago–Boston leg only, to AA1406 on 3 Aug | $0 | The Chicago waiver beats the $75 same-day fee, as PB-2026-17 says to apply whichever costs the customer least. The first flight is unchanged. |
| Q-310 | Ravi Shah (R5210) | AA216, 8 Aug | $0 | Chicago waiver. |

No refunds or travel credits were involved, so I didn't read the refund policy.

I confirmed each target flight was scheduled with seats left in the booked cabin before booking.

I didn't touch any other booking, passenger record or flight.
